races.paceDynamic: King's Code is the sole confirmed front runner in this 11-runner field and will dictate terms from the front without pressure. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Stressfree, Plage De Havre, Paddy The Squire, Saint Etienne, Sing Us A Song, Dark Moon Rising), the early pace will be comfortable, allowing King's Code to string out the field. The prominent runners (Fireblade, Will Scarlet, Klassleader, Prince Of The Seas) will track behind but won't apply early pressure. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks, as they'll get the perfect setup from an uncontested leader over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If King's Code gets an easy lead and quickens approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The front runner will have plenty left in the tank after cruising through soft fractions, making him hard to peg back up the York straight. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up despite the tactical setup favoring their style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too slow and the closers get the perfect race setup
scenarios.body: The uncontested fractions will allow the best hold-up performers to unleash devastating finishing kicks that sweep past a tiring leader. Stressfree and Plage De Havre have the class to capitalize on this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Will Scarlet or Klassleader track closer and time their move perfectly
scenarios.body: The horses sitting in behind the leader will get first run on the field and catch King's Code before the hold-up brigade can get into gear. Their tactical position gives them the jump on both the leader and the back markers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Dark Moon Rising or Saint Etienne finds unexpected improvement
scenarios.body: The lower-rated hold-up horses could benefit most from the perfect pace scenario, with their fresher profiles allowing them to outfinish more exposed rivals. The race setup could unlock latent ability in these outsiders.

watchPoints.text: King's Code must be watched for early pace - if he goes too slow he becomes vulnerable, if too fast he sets it up perfectly for closers
Plage De Havre and Stressfree both have strong hold-up profiles and could benefit most if the pace collapses late
Will Scarlet and Klassleader returning from breaks could provide the best tactical positions tracking the leader
Dark Moon Rising carrying minimum weight could be overpriced if the pace scenario plays to hold-up horses
Paddy The Squire returning from long layoff but has strong course record that shouldn't be dismissed

races.paceDynamic: Desert Falcon is the sole confirmed front-runner and will face minimal early pressure from the prominent brigade of Pocklington, Wicket Keeper, Pilgrim, and Sondad. This sets up a controlled tempo early with Desert Falcon dictating terms, before the large hold-up contingent including Fahrenheit Seven, Binhareer, Tropical Storm, and Kylian launch their challenges in the final two furlongs. With 15 of the 22 runners adopting hold-up tactics, traffic problems are inevitable in a sprint finish. The sustainable early pace followed by a cavalry charge finish clearly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Falcon maintains his advantage through controlled fractions and kicks again when challenged
scenarios.body: The large hold-up field creates traffic issues while Desert Falcon has first run on them from his uncontested position. His recent form shows he can lead and win when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the hold-up horses get clear runs in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The class horses like Fahrenheit Seven and Binhareer can unleash their superior finishing speed when getting racing room. Their higher ratings tell when the pace becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can track Desert Falcon closely and outkick him in the final 100 yards
scenarios.body: Pocklington or Pilgrim position themselves perfectly to inherit the lead when Desert Falcon tires, avoiding both the early pace battle and late traffic. They get the best of both worlds tactically.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get severely hampered and an unconsidered runner finds clear running
scenarios.body: The sheer weight of numbers in behind creates a cavalry charge where luck determines the outcome more than class. A horse drawn well or ridden patiently profits from others' misfortune.

watchPoints.text: Desert Falcon's fitness after 235 days absence - any signs of rustiness could derail the most likely winner
Traffic problems in the final furlong with 15 hold-up runners converging - several good horses will get hampered
Pocklington's ability to track Desert Falcon early - if he sits too close it could compromise both their chances
Binhareer and Sir Yoshi returning after long breaks - any market confidence would be significant given their class
The draw impact on the hold-up horses getting clear runs - high numbers may struggle to find racing room

races.paceDynamic: Regional appears the sole committed early pace angle with his prominent style, likely joined by Quinault and possibly Diligent Harry in the vanguard. With 10 of 13 runners carrying hold-up styles, this creates a compressed field with the majority sitting off a modest gallop. The lack of natural speed will produce a steadily-run affair before a furious sprint finish over the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can quicken from off the pace when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Regional sets honest fractions without serious pressure from prominent rivals
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the final quarter-mile. Horses with proven acceleration from the back like American Affair and Big Mojo can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Regional goes too steady with minimal early pressure from Quinault and Diligent Harry
scenarios.body: The pace becomes so sedate that it turns into a messy sprint where positioning trumps pure ability. This tactical lottery can catch out the best horses while favouring those drawn well with alert jockeys.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Regional gets isolated on the lead and ties up in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The early leaders pay for making the running and fade dramatically, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past. The biggest closers with proven stamina reserves benefit most from this energy-sapping scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Quinault or Diligent Harry can stalk Regional before striking in the final furlong
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers avoids the hold-up traffic and times their move to perfection from an ideal tracking position. This requires precise judgment and a clear run at the crucial moment.

Any hold-up horse that gets prominent early positioning will have a significant tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Felicitas and Moments Of Joy will clash from the start, both confirmed front runners who cannot settle behind horses. Their early battle will establish an honest gallop through the first mile, with Sea The Storm likely tracking them prominently. The middle section will see sustained pace as neither leader yields, setting up the race for the closers. This pace shape strongly favours the hold-up horses - Legacy Link, K Sarra and Della Pace - who can exploit the inevitable weakening of the early pace setters over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace Sets Up
scenarios.trigger: If both Felicitas and Moments Of Joy engage early and maintain strong fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The honest gallop exposes the front runners' stamina limitations, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the final two furlongs. Legacy Link's class and Della Pace's finishing kick become decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Felicitas or Moments Of Joy gains early supremacy while the other settles behind
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader controls fractions and maintains enough energy for the finish, while the tracking horse benefits from the slipstream. Sea The Storm's prominent position becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Start
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners show unexpected restraint or get shuffled back early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian, negating the closers' finishing advantage and favouring horses who can quicken from prominent positions. Sea The Storm and any forward-travelling hold-up horses gain the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders completely capitulate after setting unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between exhausted horses, where class and residual stamina matter most. Form horses with proven finishing speed can emerge from anywhere.

races.paceDynamic: Awraad will make the early running with only token company from the prominent brigade of Hasbro Market, Passing Thought, Inishbeg and First Time. With no genuine pace pressure, Awraad can dictate terms and set a measured gallop over this seven-furlong trip. The large field of hold-up horses will be bunched together in the rear, setting up a cavalry charge finish where positioning and a clear run will be crucial. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours the prominent runners who can track the leader without expending energy, leaving them perfectly placed to strike in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Measured Pace Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Awraad gets an easy lead and the hold-up brigade gets bunched
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent trackers to conserve energy while hold-up horses face traffic problems in a blanket finish. Hasbro Market and Inishbeg are ideally positioned to pounce when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the large field spreads out enough to provide racing room
scenarios.body: Despite the steady pace, the class hold-up performers get clear runs and their superior finishing kicks prove decisive. Al Najashi's winning streak and The Resdev Scholar's recent form come to the fore.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Awraad Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges the leader seriously until too late
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets such an easy time of it that he has enough left to repel all challengers, with the closest pursuers being those who didn't waste energy chasing. Awraad's recent course form and light weight prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaotic Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is faster than expected and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The increased tempo favours the naturally speedier types who can quicken off any pace, regardless of their usual running style. Montague Menace's recent win and Startled's finishing kick become key factors.

races.paceDynamic: Galyx represents the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field and will dictate from the front without pressure. The prominent runners Sportingsilvermine, Mafting, Fox Journey and Dwindling Funds will track behind but won't challenge the early pace. This creates a sustainable tempo that will favour the patient hold-up horses who can produce late kicks. The abundance of hold-up performers including Great Bedwyn, Master Builder, Minhad and Arrange will benefit from this tactical setup where stamina and finishing kick become paramount over early speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Galyx sets uncontested fractions and the field comes to him late
scenarios.body: The patient trackers get perfect splits and can unleash finishing kicks. The deeper pace suits stamina types who thrive when allowed to settle and produce one sustained effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking pack can get first run on the tiring leader
scenarios.body: Mafting or Fox Journey travel sweetly behind Galyx then kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Their forward position gives them the jump on closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Galyx gets soft sectionals and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a battle. His class tells when the field arrives and he digs deep to repel all challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go early creating a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The pace collapses into a messy sprint where positioning trumps ability. The handiest horse on the day gets up in a photo finish scramble.
